title: Baseline tag, full-history secret scan and rotation, org transfer, private repo, GitHub security settings and ruleset phase 1
acceptance: Repo is private in a two-owner org with 2FA required, the scan and rotation record is logged as a SOC 2 risk entry, and the main ruleset requires a PR with code-owner review and blocks force-push, deletion and bypass.

title: ADR-116 (P-02) two-founder governance text plus AGENTS.md, build-plan header, protected-paths.md, approvals README and PR template
acceptance: ADR-116 is accepted with both handles as deciders and every governance doc says a founder, never the author, using handles instead of the founder.

title: Independent AC tests for the two-founder hook, origin/main immutability, CODEOWNERS lint and immutable-path check, plus the M1 governance drill
acceptance: Tests written from ADR-116 in AY's session fail on today's hook and pass unedited on T04, and the drill shows self-approval, direct push and unreviewed protected edits are refused.

title: _protected.py two-founder fix, CODEOWNERS catch-all and gaps, codeowners_lint and immutable_paths checks
acceptance: The hook accepts approved_by of the other founder only, treats ADRs and migrations as immutable only when on origin/main (failing closed), and both checks run in CI.

title: Make main green: fix stale assertions against their spec ACs and measure coverage against fail_under 95
acceptance: A full stage-2 run is green on main, every changed assertion is traced to a spec AC with AY's approval, and coverage is recorded with a dated ADR-116 exception if below 95.

title: CI rebuild: stage 2 on push to main and merge_group, ready-for-review gating, caches, shard re-record, single Alembic head, vite build and check-generated in stage 1, ruleset phase 2
acceptance: Five consecutive main runs are green through stage 2 and the ruleset requires stage 1 (make check-fast) and stages 1 and 2 (make check).

title: Path filters that report success for backend shards on frontend- or docs-only diffs, plus a frontend job
acceptance: A frontend-only PR completes required checks in 6 minutes or less without running backend shards, while agent-path diffs still trigger evals-fast.

title: Repair the nightly e2e journey for the Setup-first flow with an idempotent seed step and nightly-red issue automation
acceptance: e2e.yml is green three nights running with expectNoSeriousViolations intact, and a red night opens or updates a nightly-red issue.

title: Worktree isolation (compose project and port offset), no-Docker fixture dev target, SessionStart context hook, local DB and deploy guard, regenerate-never-hand-merge hook
acceptance: Two worktrees run make dev side by side with separate databases, make dev-fixtures runs without Docker, DB targets refuse non-local or in-flight hosted databases, and hand edits to generated files are blocked.

title: Number blocks and numbering protocol in validate_docs plus ADR, SPEC, TASK and DEC reservation issue forms
acceptance: validate_docs rejects out-of-block or duplicate IDs and non-handle deciders on new ADRs (both handles for red), and the reservation issue forms exist.

title: Independent AC tests for the S0 CI and local-safety tooling (path classifier, check-generated, single head, db guard, generated-file hook, port offsets, number blocks)
acceptance: Tests authored in AY's session from the F-01 spec cover every S0 tool's allow and deny cases and pass unedited against T06, T07, T09 and T10.

title: PR hygiene and S4 review-record checks: [mig NNNN] title, one migration per PR, size labels against the 600-line target, reviewer and test-author separation
acceptance: Amber and red PRs fail unless reviewer model differs from author model, approver differs from author and AC-test author differs from implementer, and migration PRs carry exactly one [mig NNNN] file.

title: Release-train merge side: hold-for-batch and ship-now labels, merge-window status (Tue and Thu 17:00 CT, DST-aware) and make batch
acceptance: Outside a window an approved hold-for-batch PR cannot merge, inside a window make batch merges the green approved set in order, and a ship-now merge records its exception reason.

title: ADR P-56 release train and previews (amends ADR-088) plus docs/process/release-train.md
acceptance: The P-56 ADR is accepted by both founders by Fri Nov 13 and the process doc covers windows, hotfix lane, opt-in previews and the hosted-build database rule.

title: Escaped-defect log and weekly delivery-health summary (issue form, labels, review-queue ages against SLAs, ADR-086 clean-sprint count)
acceptance: The weekly job summary lists escaped defects by zone and sprint, open reviews past SLA (contract same day, red 1 day, amber 2) and the ADR-086 clean-sprint count, without committing to the repo.

title: Independent AC tests for the S1 tooling (pr hygiene, review record, merge window and batch, delivery health) plus a release-train dry run
acceptance: Tests from AY's session pass unedited against T12, T13 and T15, and the Tue Nov 10 and Thu Nov 12 windows merge real batches through make batch.
